Overview

Focșani is a city in Vrancea with a population of 73,868. A city in eastern Romania known for its wine production, the Union Monument marking the unification of Moldavia and Wallachia, and its strategic location. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
